note: Trend snapshot from web search on 2026-10-05 (Steal a Brainrot, Grow a Garden, Steal An Egg, Cars RNG, Horse RNG, Sol's RNG-style games, 99 Nights in the Forest). Run /refresh-suggestions to redo it.

items.title: Rebirth / prestige with a permanent multiplier
items.inspiredBy: Most idle simulators (Race Clicker, Sonic Speed Simulator)
items.description: Once a player reaches a Money or Speed threshold they can rebirth: Money and Speed reset, they keep their car index, and get a permanent multiplier (for example +25% Speed gain and Money per rebirth) plus a rebirth counter on the leaderboard.
items.fit: The Speed stat already has diminishing returns, so late players stall. Rebirth turns that stall into the next goal and gives a reason to rerun Track 1 fast.
items.dependsOn: Money upgrade tree (so rebirth can reset or keep tiers on purpose)

items.title: Rotating weather / biome events that boost luck
items.inspiredBy: Sol's RNG biomes, Grow a Garden weather events
items.description: Every 10-20 minutes a server-wide event runs for a few minutes (Rain: x2 luck, Night Race: NPCs faster but pads pay x2, Gold Rush: Money x3). A banner and a skybox / lighting change show it; some cars can only be rolled during an event.
items.fit: Rolling is free and automatic, so events give players a reason to stay online at a given moment. Plugs straight into GachaConfig luck and MoneyService multipliers.

items.title: Timed boosts (luck / money / speed potions)
items.inspiredBy: Sol's RNG and Cars RNG luck items
items.description: Consumable boosts that last 5-15 minutes: Luck x2, Money x2, Speed gain x2. Earned from track wins, daily rewards or bought with Money; stacking rules shown in a small timer row in the HUD.
items.fit: Gives Money a second use besides the upgrade tree and makes the turbo-luck rhythm more exciting.

items.title: Scrap duplicate cars for parts
items.inspiredBy: Cars RNG (sell unwanted cars to buy luck items)
items.description: Right now a duplicate roll does nothing. Instead, duplicates turn into Parts (more for rarer cars); Parts buy luck items or the upgrade tree's turbo tiers.
items.fit: Every roll then has value, even late game when the index is mostly full. Needs a save field for Parts (PlayerData VERSION bump).

items.title: Offline earnings
items.inspiredBy: Horse RNG and Grow a Garden (progress while away)
items.description: On join, pay a capped amount of Money and Speed for the time away (for example 10% of the player's average rate, up to 8 hours), shown in a 'While you were away' popup.
items.fit: This is an idle game; offline progress is the main reason idle players come back. The server already knows the save time.

items.title: Daily login streak and rewards
items.description: A 7-day reward track (Money, potions, a guaranteed rare roll on day 7) that resets if a day is missed.
items.fit: Cheap retention; rewards reuse existing systems (Money, rolls).

items.title: Rival challenges: race another player's ghost for their bank
items.inspiredBy: Steal a Brainrot / Steal An Egg (take from other players)
items.description: A player standing on a 'Challenge' pad picks another online player; they race that player's best-time ghost on a track. Winning takes a small share of the target's UNBANKED money (the target can bank it to protect it).
items.fit: Uses the existing per-player NPC ghost and the banked-money rule, and makes banking a real decision. Server decides everything, so it stays exploit-safe.

items.title: Garage showroom players can visit
items.inspiredBy: Steal a Brainrot bases, Car Dealership Tycoon
items.description: Each player gets a plot in the spawn area that shows their rarest cars on turntables. Others can walk in and see them.
items.fit: The car index already exists; showing it off is the social payoff for rare rolls.

items.title: Car trading between players
items.inspiredBy: Adopt Me!, Steal a Brainrot (trading builds a social graph)
items.description: Two-sided trade window with both players confirming; server-side validation and a trade log.
items.fit: Big for long-term engagement, but owning = discovering in the current index rules, so the index rules would have to change first.

items.title: Global leaderboards in the spawn area
items.description: OrderedDataStore boards for Speed, Money earned, rolls and rarest car, shown on signs in the spawn area.
items.fit: Cheap, and gives top players a visible goal. Server-only.

items.title: Redeem codes
items.inspiredBy: Almost every trending game (codes drive social posts)
items.description: A small codes box: each code grants Money, a potion or rolls once per player; codes listed in a server config with expiry dates.
items.fit: Low effort marketing hook for updates.

items.title: Daily quests
items.description: Three daily tasks (win 5 tracks, roll a rare, reach X speed) with rewards; rerolls at UTC midnight.
items.fit: Points players at features they skip (the NPC race, later tracks).

items.title: Friends-in-server boost
items.description: +10% luck and Money per friend in the same server, up to +40%.
items.fit: Encourages inviting friends; one multiplier in GachaService and MoneyService.

items.title: Gamepasses: 2x luck, faster auto-roll, VIP
items.description: Standard monetisation: 2x luck, roll every 2 s, x2 Money, VIP chat tag. Checked server-side with MarketplaceService.
items.fit: Matches the upgrade tree numbers, so balance it after the tree ships.

items.title: Co-op night race event
items.inspiredBy: 99 Nights in the Forest (co-op survival nights)
items.description: A timed event where everyone in the server races the chain together against one fast NPC; each track the group wins adds to a shared pot paid to all.
items.fit: Adds a social mode on top of the existing per-player races without changing them.
